Bill.BriefDescription: Removing the expiration date on the 2006 beer and wine distribution bill.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to removing the expiration date on chapter 302,Laws of 2006; and amending 2006 c 302 s 14 (uncodified).
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: 2006 c 302 s 14 (uncodified) is amended to read asfollows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: ((Except for)) Sections 9 and 11 of this act ((which)) expire July1, 2006((, this act expires June 30, 2008)).
